name: Four Beasts of The Elements
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental avatar 1st, or entropist 7th and planar array (elemental).

Benefit(s): You gain access to four beasts blast.

Special: Elemental avatars can possess this composite blast even if they normally could not possess a composite blast but cannot select this feat if they possess the avatar mutation.
